run_valuation_analyst_agent: run the valuation analyst agent across multiple tickers to generate bullish, bearish, or neutral investment signals
calculate_owner_earnings_value: calculate the intrinsic value using Buffett's owner earnings method with margin of safety and multi-year discounted cash flows
calculate_dcf_scenarios: calculate discounted cash flow valuations under bear, base, and bull scenarios with probability-weighted expected value
calculate_wacc: calculate the weighted average cost of equity and debt using CAPM, interest coverage, and a corporate tax shield
calculate_residual_income_value: calculate intrinsic value using the residual income model based on book value, cost of equity, and future residual earnings
